  PROBLEM: The bash renderer bypasses render_prompt.py's contract discovery and validation, so forbidden/required variable checks no longer run.
  WHY: The new inline substitution path only performs text replacement and unresolved-placeholder checks, leaving contract violations uncaught at render time.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:55-75 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new trimming loop strips intentional leading/trailing whitespace from continuation prompts.
  WHY: Prompt formatting that relies on indentation or trailing newlines can be altered, changing the semantics of the prompt.
- scripts/codex_thread_reuse.sh:199-206 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: codex_thread_reuse_set_session_id writes session IDs to persistent state without validating them first.
  WHY: Empty or malformed session IDs can be persisted and later break resume behavior.
- scripts/codex_thread_reuse.sh:294-311 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: Session IDs extracted from marker files are written to state without a sanity check before reuse.
  WHY: A malformed or empty ID can be passed into codex exec resume, causing repeated resume failures.
- scripts/codex_thread_reuse.sh:195-290 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Marker-based session discovery uses mtimes to pick a session and can race under concurrent jobs.
  WHY: Concurrent runs sharing a filesystem namespace can select the wrong session_id, resuming the wrong conversation.
- scripts/codex_thread_reuse.sh:520-545 | severity=medium | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: A failed resume leaves the stale session_id persisted when falling back to fresh exec.
  WHY: The fallback path does not clear the old state, so the next retry targets the dead session again.
- scripts/codex_thread_reuse.sh:580-605 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The direct-run fallback to fresh exec after a resume failure still leaves the previous session_id on disk.
  WHY: Subsequent retries re-read the same stale ID and repeat the failed resume path.
- scripts/codex_thread_reuse.sh:448-470 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Temporary prompt files are only cleaned up on the normal exit path.
  WHY: Early exits can leave mktemp-created files behind in /tmp, accumulating orphaned files over time.
- scripts/codex_thread_reuse.sh:670-690 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The wrapper_main early-exit paths can bypass cleanup of mktemp-created prompt files.
  WHY: When the process exits before the trailing rm -f calls, the temporary prompt files are leaked.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:694-723 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Continuation-prompt rendering and wrapper installation failures are swallowed and silently fall back to the full-prompt path.
  WHY: The || true / silent warning paths hide why continuation was not used, making the optimization appear unavailable without diagnostics.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2489-2510 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The helper is sourced without checking whether sourcing succeeded.
  WHY: Parse or load failures can silently disable thread reuse without making the source error visible.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:5070-5099 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The workflow's thread-reuse continuation path assumes the probe populated CODEX_THREAD_REUSE_AVAILABLE.
  WHY: If the probe is skipped or its output is lost, the workflow silently falls back without a clear distinction between “unavailable” and “not probed”.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- File: scripts/memory_helpers.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 434-end (deletion of _memory_force_tick_remote_url, _memory_force_tick_remote_branch_exists, _memory_force_tick_ensure_branch, _memory_force_tick_collision_wrapper, memory_force_tick_get, memory_force_tick_put)
  Problem: The PR deletes 413 lines containing the force-tick collision-detection helper functions. scripts/orchestrate_force_tick.sh gates its dedup path on declare -F memory_force_tick_get and declare -F memory_force_tick_put at lines 335, 371, 393, and 433. After this deletion, those declarations return false, and the entire force-tick dedup path is silently disabled with no operator-visible warning or fallback.
  Why it fails at runtime: On any poll cycle where force-tick dedup should suppress a redundant dispatch, the declare -F check will evaluate to false, the guarded block will be skipped, and a duplicate force-tick dispatch will proceed. This wastes runner time and API quota on redundant dispatches that the dedup was designed to prevent.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: scripts/render_prompt.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 43-82 (the new while-read-case loop replacing the exec render_prompt.py call)
  Problem: The rewrite from Python-delegated rendering to inline bash substitution drops render_prompt.py's contract-discovery and validation path (discover_contract_path, PromptContract checks for required_vars, optional_vars, forbidden_vars). The three new continuation prompt templates each have a corresponding prompts/contracts/*.yml file specifying forbidden_vars like WORKFLOW_EDIT_RESTRICTION and SEMBLE_PREFETCH, but the new bash path only performs text substitution without validating that callers respect the contract. If a future caller accidentally passes a forbidden variable to a continuation prompt, the contract violation will not be caught at render time.
  Why it fails at runtime: A continuation prompt rendered with a forbidden variable (e.g., WORKFLOW_EDIT_RESTRICTION injected into a prompt that should not carry workflow-edit policy) would produce a prompt with incorrect constraints, potentially causing the model to make or avoid edits contrary to the intended contract. The issue is currently latent because the implement.yml callsites for continuation prompts only pass SERENA_TOOL_HINTS (which is in optional_vars), but the validation gap is real and will not catch future misuse.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
